heroLine: I'm a junior studying computer science at WPI, looking for software engineering internships for summer 2027.
about:
Hi, I'm Gabriel.

This past summer I was an AI Integration intern at Gratinsta. Lately, outside of classes, I've been working on my home lab and a Raspberry Pi cluster that hosts my own services.

When I'm not working on these, I'm usually outdoors, backpacking and hiking, or skiing in the winter. I also love learning languages (German at the moment) and recently began learning guitar.
